title: The channel cover
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Friday. The cover is the channel at the minus tide, the far water, the sky in it. No figures, no prints. The owner says it's the same as January. Wood says it's the opposite. She looks longer this time without being told.

panels.composition: The cover: the channel across the flats, the sky in it, the mud either side. Nothing else.

image.prompt: close on a photocopied booklet cover showing a tidal channel across mudflats reflecting the sky, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The laundromat. The LAUNDRY owner. WOOD. BARNABY.

image.prompt: a laundromat owner considering a small booklet's cover while a young man and a dog wait, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The owner looking longer. Nobody told her to.

image.prompt: a laundromat owner looking at a booklet cover for a long moment, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The digest in the rack. The January one still there in the back. Two grays, opposite. Only the strip knows.

image.prompt: a wire rack in a laundromat holding a fresh booklet in front of an older one, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: 'It's the sky. It's out.' She looks longer unprompted.
